referenceGeneration.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single-object reference image for Meshy image-to-3D generation, for a mobile basketball game.
Primary request: one attractive classic orange basketball, a clean premium stylized 3D game prop, physically spherical with a perfectly circular silhouette, centred and entirely visible.
Scene/backdrop: plain neutral light gray studio background, no floor or ground plane, no contact shadow, no surrounding objects.
Subject: a regulation-style eight-panel basketball, rich warm orange rubber panels separated by continuous thin charcoal-black recessed channels in a conventional symmetric basketball seam pattern. Show a three-quarter orientation with the recognisable centre seam and curving side seams. All channels lie flush in the spherical surface, no raised strips, no detached pieces. Subtle fine pebbled rubber grain, broad clean panels, smooth spherical silhouette.
Style/medium: polished appealing stylized 3D asset render compatible with a colourful island sports game, slightly simplified surface detail, believable matte rubber, nonmetallic.
Composition/framing: square image; one ball fills about 80 percent of the frame, generous clear margin all around, orthographic-like product view, no perspective distortion.
Lighting: very soft even neutral illumination; readable colour and grooves, restrained smooth shading, no dramatic shadows or bright specular glare.
Constraints: only one basketball; no hands, hoop, stand, pedestal, floor, text, numbers, logos, branding, labels, arrows, glow, flames, motion trails or watermark. No flattening, lobes, dents or inflation nipple sticking out. Keep detail primarily in surface colour and shallow grooves for a lightweight game mesh.
